summary: Coupon feature (WELCOME50 + FLAT100) tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases passing — /api/coupons/validate handles success, ineligible product (400), invalid code (404), empty code (400), case-insensitive lookup, and preview math (rupee floor). /api/payments/create-order server-computes discounted amount for employer_unlock (₹199→9950 paise with WELCOME50), freelancer_onboarding (₹99→4950 paise), and plans (FLAT100 subtracts ₹100 in paise). ₹1 minimum floor confirmed via validate math (FLAT100 on ₹99 clamps to ₹1 final). Frontend: 4 of 5 payment windows verified via mobile viewport — /employer/plans sheet (plan-coupon-*), /employer unlock bottom sheet (unlock-coupon-*), /pro/[id] profile (pro-coupon-*), and /freelancer Step 1 (onboarding-coupon-*) all render CouponInput correctly. WELCOME50 applied row, remove (X) button, and invalid-code inline error work as designed. FLAT100 on employer_unlock correctly shows 'This coupon doesn't apply to this purchase.' The 5th window (quota-boost paywall in /freelancer/jobs) is code-verified only (testIDPrefix='boost-coupon' at jobs.tsx:729) — reaching it requires a verified freelancer who exhausted 3 free applies, out of scope for this pass. UX ISSUE: the 'Pay ₹X' CTA button/title in all 4 sheets shows the ORIGINAL price even after a coupon is applied (server sends correct discounted amount to Razorpay). This is a display-only inconsistency worth polishing.

ui_bugs.issue: Pay ₹X button/title label doesn't update when coupon is applied — shows original price while applied-row shows discounted amount. Server-side amount is correct, only UI label mismatch. Files: /app/frontend/app/employer/index.tsx:435,470; /app/frontend/app/employer/plans.tsx:207,245; /app/frontend/app/freelancer/index.tsx (Pay Onboarding Fee ₹99); /app/frontend/app/pro/[id].tsx (UNLOCK THIS LEAD ₹199).

action_items: OPTIONAL UX POLISH: Update the Pay CTA text in all 4 payment sheets to reflect the applied coupon's final_amount (e.g., 'Pay ₹99 with Razorpay' instead of stale ₹199). Suggested pattern: derive displayed amount from applied?.final_amount ?? originalAmount.
critical_code_review_comments: Server-side amount authority is correctly enforced — client-supplied amount is never trusted in /api/payments/create-order (uses PRODUCT_AMOUNTS_PAISE or PLAN_CATALOG lookup).
Discount floor logic (max(0, min(disc, amount_paise - 100))) in _discount_paise correctly guards Razorpay's ₹1 minimum.
Coupon lookup is case-insensitive via .strip().upper() before Mongo _id lookup — good.
Coupon used_count is only incremented on successful payment verification (server.py:1003-1004), not on order creation — correct semantics.
seed_data_creation: Re-inserted test session (test_token_workhop_e2e for user_testauto0001) into MongoDB test_database (users + user_sessions) — GET /api/auth/me returns 200 with expected user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coupon feature is production-ready. If main agent adds the pay-CTA label update, retest by applying WELCOME50 on /employer/plans → Buy Starter Bundle sheet → confirm the 'Pay ₹999 with Razorpay' button changes to 'Pay ₹499'. Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_coupons.py.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only cosmetic Pay-CTA text stale after coupon apply.
